serengeti-grand-migration.lead: Twelve days timed around the Great Migration: Tarangire’s baobabs, Ngorongoro’s crater floor and a mobile camp in the Serengeti’s northern crossing zone.

reasons.d: Three nights in an exclusive mobile tented camp in the northern Serengeti, the migration’s prime crossing zone, where wildebeest surge across the Mara River in their tens of thousands.
A full-day descent into the Ngorongoro Crater, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, and Tarangire’s big elephant herds among ancient baobabs.
A sunrise balloon over the Serengeti with a champagne breakfast on the plains, and night game drives for leopards, lions and aardvarks.

serengeti-grandeur.lead: A private 125,000-acre concession with no other vehicles, then the classic central Serengeti, with two charter flights doing the heavy lifting.

reasons.d: Four nights at Mwiba Lodge in a private concession where there are no other vehicles and no crowds, with the Big Five, cheetah and wild dog.

reasons.t: On foot with an armed ranger
reasons.d: A walking safari tracking predators across the concession, and a dawn balloon over the Serengeti followed by a champagne bush breakfast.
Four nights at Serengeti Explorer Elewana in the central Serengeti, for lion prides at the Simba Kopjes, leopards in the Seronera forest and cheetah with cubs.

south-africa-apex-reserves-kruger-sabisa.lead: Two Singita lodges, one for Sabi Sand’s leopards and one for Kruger’s wide plains, with a photographic safari led by a dedicated lodge photographer.

reasons.d: Off-road leopard tracking in the Sabi Sand, with sightings at remarkably close range, after a champagne sundowner beneath ancient weeping boerbean trees.
Singita Boulders in the Sabi Sand, then Singita Lebombo, a glass-and-steel lodge perched on a dramatic rock gorge in Kruger.
A dedicated lodge photographer teaches predator light and composition, with a sunrise balloon over the Sabie River valley and a live-cooking breakfast on a granite ridge.

south-africa-cape-elegance-historic-wine.lead: Cape Town, the winelands and the Whale Coast in ten days, with private touches at every stop instead of queues.

reasons.d: A private Table Mountain cable car ride, a sparkling wine sundowner on Signal Hill, and Cape Point and Boulders Beach’s penguin colony in a single day.
A private cellar tour and masterclass tasting at a Franschhoek estate, and a sunrise balloon over the Berg River Valley’s vineyards with a champagne brunch.
A private tour of the Dylan Lewis Sculpture Garden, with more than 60 bronzes against the Stellenbosch Mountains, then a stay on the Whale Coast at Birkenhead House.

south-africa-garden-route-ancient-karoo.lead: A scenic journey from Plettenberg Bay to the Little Karoo: ancient forest, a private yacht through Knysna Heads, and caves without the crowds.

reasons.d: A private luxury yacht through the Knysna Heads, between cliffs over 100 metres high, with fresh oysters, chilled champagne and frequent dolphins and whales.
800-year-old Outeniqua Yellowwood trees in the Tsitsikamma Forest, and a crossing of the Storms River suspension bridge over its gorge.
A sunrise balloon over the Little Karoo’s sandstone formations, a private after-hours tour of the Cango Caves, the Swartberg Pass and a night of stargazing.

south-africa-red-sands-malaria-free-gian.lead: The Kalahari’s red dunes and meerkats at Tswalu, then malaria-free Madikwe for wild dogs and rhino.

reasons.d: South Africa’s largest private reserve, for tracking black-maned lions, pangolins and aardvarks, and sitting beside a habituated meerkat colony at dawn.
A whisky and gin sundowner atop a red Kalahari dune, a night on the star-bed deck beneath the Milky Way, and a sunrise balloon over the ancient dunes.
Molori Safari Lodge in a malaria-free reserve famous for its wild dog packs and large rhino populations, with a look at conservation work behind the scenes.

southern-african-grand-safari.lead: Twenty-seven days across Botswana, Zimbabwe, Zambia, Namibia and South Africa: delta, falls, river and desert in one connected journey.

reasons.d: A silent mokoro through the Okavango’s channels, a sunrise balloon over the Delta, Victoria Falls, and a Zambezi sunset cruise along nine miles of private riverfront.
Walking safaris in South Luangwa, the park that invented them, and Chief’s Camp in Moremi on one of Southern Africa’s finest game-viewing traverses.
Etosha from Mokuti, leopard country at Lion Sands in the Sabi Sand, and a coastal finish at Plettenberg Bay.

southern-wilderness-apex-views.lead: Kilimanjaro views from your suite, Super Tusker elephants and a night drive in the Chyulu Hills, ending in Tsavo’s volcanic country.

reasons.d: Two nights at Angama Amboseli, in a luxury suite looking straight at Mount Kilimanjaro, plus a sunrise balloon with a champagne bush breakfast.
Tracking Amboseli’s famous Super Tusker elephants against the backdrop of Africa’s highest peak.

reasons.t: The Chyulu Hills, day and night
reasons.d: A night drive tracking leopard, serval and bushbabies, a high-altitude walking safari through volcanic cloud forest, and a horseback ridge ride.

sovereign-mara-conservancies.lead: Three private Mara conservancies in ten days, with your own 4x4 and driver-guide throughout, so every game drive is yours to direct.

reasons.d: Exclusive access across Ol Kinyei, Mara Naboisho and Olare Motorogi for pristine wildlife encounters away from the busiest parts of the reserve.
Porini Ol Kinyei Cottages, Saruni Leopard Hill and Mahali Mzuri, with Hemingways Nairobi’s butler service at either end.
A professional driver-guide and a private 4x4 Land Cruiser the whole way, plus a balloon over the Olare Motorogi plains with a champagne breakfast.

the-1923.lead: A safari staged as an expedition from 1923: light aircraft to a private airstrip, a printed Expedition Journal and a day with no timetable.

reasons.d: A light aircraft from Wilson Airport direct to Cottar’s private airstrip, so the flight itself becomes part of the expedition.
A physical Expedition Journal with a map, wildlife checklist, historical notes and the story of The 1923, to take home.

An expert naturalist teaches tracks, birds and predator behaviour, with a 1923 bush picnic, a walking safari, a respectful Maasai visit and a Great Mara Expedition day with no fixed timetable, ending in a farewell dinner around the fire.

the-monarchs-untamed-mara.lead: From Ol Kinyei’s hidden valley to Angama Mara’s escarpment, ten days in some of the Mara’s best-protected corners with expert naturalist guides.

reasons.d: Exclusive access to prime wildlife areas, beginning at Porini Ol Kinyei Cottages and Saruni Leopard Hill in the Mara conservancies.
Expert naturalist guides with deep knowledge of predator tracking and wildlife behaviour on every drive.

reasons.t: A VIP start, a sky finish
reasons.d: JW Marriott Nairobi with VIP customs fast-track and butler service, then a balloon over the Maasai Mara National Reserve with a champagne breakfast and a stay at Angama Mara.

uganda-gorilla-riverine-giants.lead: Tree-climbing lions, a hippo-lined channel and a quiet hour with a gorilla family in Bwindi: Uganda’s wild highlights in ten days.

reasons.d: A quiet hour face to face with a silverback family in Bwindi, followed by a white-linen gourmet breakfast in an open forest clearing.
The tree-climbing lions of Ishasha, and a private boat cruise on the Kazinga Channel past hundreds of hippos, drinking elephants and fish eagles.
A torch-lit bonfire dinner on a deck over Bwindi’s canopy, and a walk with Batwa forest people sharing traditional hunting techniques and medicinal plant knowledge.
